card.name: Domestic vs international scope words
card.fires_on: The word domestic, and sometimes international, worldwide or UK, when it marks a geographic scope such as home-country versus overseas. Seen in general web text about business, politics and organizations.

modes.label: Domestic
modes.description: The word domestic describing home-country operations, jobs or programs.
modes.example: PLATO Learning has<< domestic>> offices located throughout the United States,

modes.label: International or worldwide
modes.description: Words such as international, worldwide or UK that mark a wider geographic scope.
modes.example: and the<< international>> best seller When Corporations Rule the World

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are a mix of unrelated words, with some overseas-themed Chinese terms suppressed.
card.plain: It lights up on words like domestic or worldwide that say whether something is home-country or international.
